'''Zsajhira berry tea''' was a specially brewed beverage produced from the black-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Zsajhira berry|Zsajhira berries]] that grew on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Another key ingredient of the [[Tea/Legends|tea]] was [[Water/Legends|water]]&mdash;ranking among the purest in Socorro's [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]]&mdash;from the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system's]] ice world [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. The Socorro-based company [[Ethra Brewery]], the only producer of beverages in the Socorro [[Star system/Legends|system]], maintained a monopoly on the manufacture of Zsajhira [[Berry/Legends|berry]] tea, which was a popular commodity on several worlds of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Socorro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zsajhira berry tea was introduced in ''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]'', a [[1997]] sourcebook authored by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Socorro" />
